elements.label: Gradient orb shrinking into avatar badge
Agent greeting line 1
elements.text: Hi, this is Eric from BoundEvents.

pattern.description: The large centred gradient orb shrinks and travels to the top-right corner while a chat bubble with the agent's greeting fades in beneath it, so the orb ends as the speaking agent's avatar badge on the bubble; the whole bubble group then settles slightly smaller and to the right.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous object carries identity from the abstract brand visual into the concrete UI: the orb becomes the agent's face on the message, giving the cut-free handoff from concept to demo and landing the bubble just before the voice says 'Hi'.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(orb, {scale: 0.15, x: badgeX, y: badgeY, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.inOut'}, 0).fromTo(bubble, {opacity: 0, scale: 1.4}, {opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3.out'}, 0.25).fromTo([line1, line2], {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, stagger: 0.05, ease: 'power2.out'}, 0.3). Use transformOrigin at the badge corner so bubble and orb scale together; parent orb into the bubble group after the move.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120}}); orbScale = interpolate(p, [0,1], [1, 0.15]); orbX/orbY interpolate to badge position; bubble opacity = interpolate(frame, [7, 15], [0, 1], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); bubble scale = interpolate(p, [0,1], [1.4, 1]); text lines delay 1-2 frames each.

notes: camera.move is none; pan_x 0.32 and scale 0.37 come from the orb shrinking and travelling right. The bubble's own size change between the burst and the settled end frame is ambiguous (it may be a separate settle). Could alternatively be filed as match_cut_element or notification_pop.
